metadata.description: 40-question adversarial QA dataset with misleading contexts, near-miss distractors, and low-signal retrieval tasks to test robustness of reranking strategies

question_types.misleading_context: Correct answer present but surrounded by highly similar but incorrect statements
question_types.near_miss_distractor: Distractors that are factually close to correct answer (off by unit/coefficient/order)
question_types.unanswerable: Question cannot be answered from given corpus (requires external knowledge)
question_types.ambiguous: Multiple valid answers or interpretation required

questions.question: What is Planck's constant value in SI units (J·s)?
questions.distractor_notes: Near-miss: off by one order of magnitude, very similar numerically

questions.question: What is the speed of sound in air at 20°C in m/s?
questions.distractor_notes: Near-miss: adjacent values and off-by-order misleading

questions.question: What is the molecular weight of ethanol (C2H5OH) in g/mol?
questions.distractor_notes: Off-by-one in carbon/hydrogen count, very close to correct answer

questions.question: What is the activation energy for the SN2 reaction of chloromethane with hydroxide ion in aprotic solvent?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires specific experimental data not in general corpus

questions.question: How many nucleotides are in a complete turn of the DNA double helix?
questions.distractor_notes: Small integer differences can cause major biological implications

questions.question: What is the current population of Arctic foxes in the Siberian tundra as of 2024?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires real-time ecological survey data

questions.question: What is the derivative of f(x) = x^3 + 2x^2 - 5x + 1?
questions.distractor_notes: Single sign/coefficient errors that look correct without careful verification

questions.question: What is the determinant of the matrix [[2, 3], [4, 5]]?
questions.distractor_notes: Sign is critical; easy to confuse order of operations

questions.question: What is the exact mineral composition percentage of the deepest crustal layer under the Mariana Trench?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires deep geological surveys not yet available

questions.question: What is the highest temperature ever recorded on Earth's surface?
questions.distractor_notes: Record holders and measurement disputes make this ambiguous; values very close

questions.question: What is the time complexity of merge sort in the worst case?
distractors: O(n log n) with O(n) space
questions.distractor_notes: Correct complexity but space is often confused; tests deep understanding

questions.question: What is the optimal index strategy for a specific query on tables with 5.2B rows and cardinality distribution X?
distractors: Create a composite index on columns A, B, C
Use hash index on primary key
Create bitmap index on all columns
questions.distractor_notes: Requires specific workload characteristics and database statistics

questions.question: What is the magnetic field produced by a long straight wire carrying current I at distance r?
questions.distractor_notes: Common algebraic variations that look plausible without derivation

questions.question: What is the gravitational acceleration at Earth's surface?
questions.distractor_notes: Rounding and location variations create near-identical answers

questions.question: What is the exact standard free energy of formation for a hypothetical compound XY₄ at 37°C?
questions.distractor_notes: Hypothetical compound requires synthesis data not in literature

questions.question: What is the pH of a 0.1 M HCl solution?
questions.distractor_notes: Integer vs precise calculation distinction

questions.question: What percentage of the human genome is protein-coding?
questions.distractor_notes: Historically disputed; exact percentage varies by definition

questions.question: What is the exact number of mitochondria in a human liver cell from a specific individual under specific conditions?
questions.distractor_notes: Cell-specific and condition-dependent, highly variable

questions.question: What is the next prime number after 1000?
questions.distractor_notes: Many near values are composite; easy to miscalculate

questions.question: What is the exact probability that a randomly selected integer has a specific Diophantine property?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires Ramsey theory computation not feasible

questions.question: What is the current atmospheric CO₂ concentration in ppm (2024)?
questions.distractor_notes: Year-dependent; exact value changes annually

questions.question: What is the exact current velocity at a specific point in the Gulf Stream on July 15, 2026?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires real-time oceanographic measurements

questions.question: What is the time complexity of finding an element in a balanced binary search tree?
questions.distractor_notes: Correct answer but implementation details often confused

questions.question: What is the optimal routing algorithm for a specific network topology with dynamic packet loss?
questions.distractor_notes: Depends on specific network parameters and loss distribution

questions.question: What is the speed of light in vacuum?
questions.distractor_notes: Precision and unit variations create multiple near-correct answers

questions.question: What is the exact orbital overlap integral for a specific molecular geometry?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires quantum mechanical calculations specific to system

questions.question: Approximately how many species exist on Earth?
questions.distractor_notes: Estimates vary widely; exact number unknown and constantly changing

questions.question: What is the exact epicenter location of the next significant earthquake?
questions.distractor_notes: Earthquake prediction is fundamentally uncertain

questions.question: What is the circumference of a circle with radius 5?
questions.distractor_notes: Formula confusion and approximation precision issues

questions.question: What is the purpose of the softmax function in neural networks?
questions.distractor_notes: Multiple plausible-sounding but incomplete answers

questions.question: What is the exact refractive index of a specific organic polymer blend at a particular wavelength?
questions.distractor_notes: Material-specific and requires empirical measurement

questions.question: What is the concentration of a solution if 25 mL of 0.1 M HCl is diluted to 250 mL?
questions.distractor_notes: Dilution formula easily misapplied; off-by-factor errors common

questions.question: How many antibody isotypes does the human immune system produce?
questions.distractor_notes: Small integer counts easy to confuse

questions.question: What is the exact crystal structure parameter for a newly discovered mineral?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires X-ray crystallography data for specific specimen

questions.question: In a normal distribution, what percentage of data falls within 2 standard deviations?
questions.distractor_notes: Similar percentages for different standard deviations create confusion

questions.question: What is the optimal encryption key length for protecting data until year 2100?
questions.distractor_notes: Depends on future computational advances and threat models

questions.question: What is the Reynolds number for water flowing through a pipe at standard conditions?
questions.distractor_notes: Laminar/turbulent transition values are well-known but context-dependent

questions.question: What is the exact stability constant for a specific metal-ligand complex at pH 5.2?
questions.distractor_notes: Requires experimental measurement at specific conditions

questions.question: What is the Km value of the enzyme glucose oxidase for its substrate?
questions.distractor_notes: Unit confusion (mM vs μM vs nM) is critical error

questions.question: What is the age of the Earth in years?
questions.distractor_notes: Similar estimates with uncertainty ranges

questions.question: What is the cardinality of the continuum hypothesis solution set?
questions.distractor_notes: Undecidable in standard ZFC axioms

questions.question: What is the Chomsky hierarchy level of context-free languages?
questions.distractor_notes: Correct answer with incorrect reasoning still present
